outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry dot/pseudocolor plots showing individual events per cell; each dot represents an individual data point (a single cell), and gate percentages are derived from this raw event display, not an averaged bar/summary chart.
Flow cytometry scatter plots displaying individual cell events; this is a scatter-type plot, not a bar chart of averages, so individual data points are inherently shown.
Sequential flow cytometry gating plots showing individual cell events as dots; no averaged summary statistic is being plotted here.
Color-coded overlay scatter plot of individual cells (MBC, GC, naive populations); each point is an individual cell event, not an averaged value.
Flow cytometry scatter plots with gating percentages showing individual cell events; scatter plots inherently display individual data points, so no additional overlay is required.
